abstract: Collects volunteer support registers and neighborhood neighborhood council endorsements
system_message:
You are Community Resilience Liaison (CRL). The Community Resilience Liaison (CRL) tracks community stakeholder engagement and community asset readiness for municipal facilities considered during emergency shelter activation. Responsibilities include gathering local advisory council endorsements and maintaining certified registers of bilingual emergency volunteers within surrounding neighborhoods.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Multilingual staff registry（LANG）
information_points.content:
CRL-LANG-UHI：Based on the volunteer coordinator registry, Highland Civic Gymnasium has a registered bilingual volunteer roster of 8 volunteers certified and available for 12-hour shifts living within 3 km of the facility.
CRL-LANG-Z8N：The volunteer coordinator registry reports Metro Technical Exhibition Hall has a registered bilingual volunteer roster of 14 volunteers certified for 12-hour shifts residing within a 3 km radius.
CRL-LANG-M08：Records from the volunteer coordinator registry indicate Riverside Cultural Pavilion maintains a registered bilingual volunteer roster of 22 volunteers living within 3 km who are certified for 12-hour operational shifts.

information_points.title: Collects volunteer support registers and neighborhood neighborhood council endorsements（SURV）
information_points.content:
CRL-SURV-4FS：The district advisory council resolution survey shows that Riverside Cultural Pavilion received a neighborhood council endorsement rating of 92% affirmative votes from voting local advisory board members.
CRL-SURV-FZK：According to the district advisory council resolution survey, Highland Civic Gymnasium achieved a neighborhood council endorsement rating of 78% affirmative votes among local neighborhood advisory board members voting on the shelter location.
CRL-SURV-RM6：For Metro Technical Exhibition Hall, the district advisory council resolution survey records a neighborhood council endorsement rating of 64% affirmative votes cast by local advisory board members regarding shelter placement.
